sources.title: MoshiRAG: Real-Time Duplex Speech LM
sources.snippet: MoshiRAG is a modular full-duplex speech language model framework that combines a compact streaming core with asynchronous retrieval of up-to-date knowledge. It minimizes hallucinations by selectively retrieving and injecting concise factual references during conversational dialogue.
